title: AI_LOOP_STATE.md overflow check counts entries, not bytes
body: detectLoopStateOverflow limits the number of live cycle entries, but the cycle prompt asks for at most 8 lines per entry and entries average 2,610 bytes (max 4,050), so the ledger every agent reads is 42 KB against a contract it does not enforce. Add a byte ceiling per entry (or for the live section) alongside the entry cap, and let loop:rotate-state trim to it. From docs/REPO_AUDIT_2026-09.md finding 1.
